Citi® Merchant OffersReady, set save with Citi® Merchant Offers. With this statement-credit program you can save on shopping, dining, travel and more. To get started, explore the Merchant Offers available to you, enroll in your favorites and complete the qualifying purchases stated in the offer details to earn your statement credit.
Citi® Flex PayBuy now, pay later with Citi® Flex Pay. Pay over time in fixed monthly payments and continue to earn points on purchases. Available on eligible purchases of $75 or more. 2FAQsWhat kind of card is Citi Double Cash®?The Citi Double Cash® Card is a Mastercard credit card that provides Cardmembers with cash back rewards. Cardmembers earn 2% cash back by earning 1% cash back on purchases, plus an additional 1% cash back as they pay for those purchases. In addition, earn 3% cash back on hotels, car rentals, and attractions booked with Citi Travel. Cash back is earned in the form of ThankYou® Points. This means each billing cycle, you will earn 1 ThankYou® Point per $1 spent on purchases and an additional ThankYou® Point for every $1 paid on those purchases.
Plus: Earn an additional of 3 points for every $1 spent on hotels, car rentals, and attractions booked with Citi Travel. When combined with the 1 ThankYou point per $1 on your purchases and the 1 ThankYou point per $1 on your payments, this totals to 5 ThankYou points per $1 spent. To earn cash back, pay at least the minimum payment on time. And, with no annual fee1, the Citi Double Cash® Card offers another great reason for Cardmembers to use it for their everyday purchases.How do you redeem for rewards?Citi Double Cash® Card lets you redeem your points in a variety of ways:
ThankYou® Points can be easily redeemed for cash back such as a statement credit, direct deposit or check. For example, you can redeem 10,000 ThankYou® Points for a $100 statement credit, a $100 Check by Mail, or as a $100 direct deposit to your bank account.
You can also redeem your points for other rewards such as gift cards, Shop with Points at Amazon, travel and more. Redemption rates may vary.
There are no minimums when you redeem for a statement credit or direct deposit. Visit ThankYou.com to learn more.
What is the APR for Citi Double Cash® Card?The standard variable APR for purchases on the Citi Double Cash® Card is dependent on a margin added to the prime rate. See Pricing Details1Read more Citi Double Cash® Card FAQs What is the credit limit for the Citi Double Cash® Card?
As with any credit card, the credit limit for the Citi Double Cash® Card is determined based on the Cardholder's creditworthiness. Learn more about the Citi Double Cash® Credit Card.
How can I apply for the Citi Double Cash® Card?
The application process for the Citi Double Cash® Card is easy and straightforward. Learn more and apply online.
What are the fees associated with the Citi Double Cash® Card?
The Citi Double Cash® Card does not charge an annual fee.1 However, other fees may apply if cardholders use services such as balance transfers or cash advances. Full information about fees can be found in documentation with your new card. See Pricing Details1
Is there a limit to the amount of cash back I can receive on the Citi Double Cash® Card?
There is no limit to the amount of cash back you can earn with the Citi Double Cash® Card. After each promotional period ends, a variable APR of 18.49% - 28.74%, based on your creditworthiness, applies to unpaid promotional balances, new purchases and new balance transfers. For Citi Flex Plans subject to an APR, the variable APR is 18.49% - 28.74%, based on creditworthiness. For Citi Flex Pay Plans subject to a Plan Fee, a monthly fee of up to 1.72% will apply, based on the Citi Flex Plan duration, the APR that would otherwise apply to the Transaction, and other factors. The variable cash advance APR — 29.99%. Variable Penalty APR up to 29.99% and applies if you pay late or your payment is returned. Minimum interest charge — $0.50. Annual Fee — $0. Fee for foreign purchases — 3% of the U.S. dollar amount of each purchase. Cash advance fee — either $10 or 5% of the amount of each cash advance, whichever is greater. Balance transfer fee – either $5 or 5% of the amount of each transfer, whichever is greater.New cardmembers only. Subject to credit approval. Additional limitations, terms and conditions apply. Available on eligible purchases of $75 or more. 2FAQsWhat kind of card is Citi Double Cash®?The Citi Double Cash® Card is a Mastercard credit card that provides Cardmembers with cash back rewards. Cardmembers earn 2% cash back by earning 1% cash back on purchases, plus an additional 1% cash back as they pay for those purchases. In addition, earn 3% cash back on hotels, car rentals, and attractions booked with Citi Travel. Cash back is earned in the form of ThankYou® Points. This means each billing cycle, you will earn 1 ThankYou® Point per $1 spent on purchases and an additional ThankYou® Point for every $1 paid on those purchases.
Plus: Earn an additional of 3 points for every $1 spent on hotels, car rentals, and attractions booked with Citi Travel. When combined with the 1 ThankYou point per $1 on your purchases and the 1 ThankYou point per $1 on your payments, this totals to 5 ThankYou points per $1 spent. To earn cash back, pay at least the minimum payment on time. And, with no annual fee1, the Citi Double Cash® Card offers another great reason for Cardmembers to use it for their everyday purchases.How do you redeem for rewards?Citi Double Cash® Card lets you redeem your points in a variety of ways:
ThankYou® Points can be easily redeemed for cash back such as a statement credit, direct deposit or check. For example, you can redeem 10,000 ThankYou® Points for a $100 statement credit, a $100 Check by Mail, or as a $100 direct deposit to your bank account.
You can also redeem your points for other rewards such as gift cards, Shop with Points at Amazon, travel and more. Redemption rates may vary.
There are no minimums when you redeem for a statement credit or direct deposit. Visit ThankYou.com to learn more.
